[1] It was also the only Motown song to reach the Top 10 on the US "Billboard" Hot 100 that year and the Commodores's first Billboard Hot 100 number-one hit, topping the chart for two weeks on August 12, 1978 and also went to number one on the soul chart for two weeks.
[2] It features 21 tracks including the "Billboard" Hot 100 number-one hit, "Blank Space" by Taylor Swift.
[3] "Blank Space" is a song by American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift from her fifth studio album "1989" (2014).
[4] The song was released to the radio by Republic Records on November 10, 2014 as the album's second single, after "Shake It Off" and is the second track on the album.
